56000.meaningLit: discourse on the question about the world

56001.meaning1: contained within the world; part of the world

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu lokassa antam'āgamma, lokassa ante viharati. tam'aññe evam'āhaṃsu, ayam'pi lokapariyāpanno, ayam'pi anissaṭo lokamhā'ti. aham'pi hi, brāhmaṇā, evaṃ vadāmi, ayam'pi lokapariyāpanno, ayam'pi anissaṭo lokamhā'ti.

56002.meaning1: way of the world; how the world works; nature of things

examples.text: na ve dhīrā pakubbanti, viditvā lokapariyāyaṃ, aññāya nibbutā dhīrā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.

56003.commentary: (JAa) lokapālā'ti evarūpānaṃ sīlavantīnaṃ patidevatānaṃ pālakā lokapālā nūna idha loke na santī'ti

examples.text: na santi devā pavasanti nūna, na hi nūna santi idha lokapālā, sahasā karontānam'asaññatānaṃ, na hi nūna santī paṭisedhitāro.

56005.meaning1: universal supporter; friend of the world

56006.meaning1: thinking about the world; conceiving the world
56006.commentary: (SNa) cakkhunā kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī'ti cakkhuñ'hi loke appahīnadiṭṭhi puthujjano sattalokavasena loko'ti sañjānāti c'eva maññati ca, tathā cakkavāḷalokavasena. na hi aññatra cakkh'ādīhi dvādas'āyatanehi tassa sā saññā vā māno vā uppajjati. tena vuttaṃ, cakkhunā kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī'ti. imassa ca lokassa gamanena anto nāma ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pattuṃ vā na sakkā.

examples.text: kāyena kho, āvuso… manena kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī. yena kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī, ayaṃ vuccati ariyassa vinaye loko.
satthā ca me lokam'imaṃ adhiṭṭhahi, aniccato addhuvato asārato, pakkhanda maṃ citta jinassa sāsane, tārehi oghā mahatā suduttarā.
saññaṃ pariññā vitareyya oghaṃ, pariggahesu muni n'opalitto, abbūḷhasallo caram'appamatto, n'āsīsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.

56008.commentary: (SNa) cakkhunā kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī'ti cakkhuñ'hi loke appahīnadiṭṭhi puthujjano sattalokavasena loko'ti sañjānāti c'eva maññati ca, tathā cakkavāḷalokavasena. na hi aññatra cakkh'ādīhi dvādas'āyatanehi tassa sā saññā vā māno vā uppajjati. tena vuttaṃ, cakkhunā kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī'ti. imassa ca lokassa gamanena anto nāma ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pattuṃ vā na sakkā.

examples.text: kāyena kho, āvuso… manena kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī. yena kho, āvuso, lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī, ayaṃ vuccati ariyassa vinaye loko.

56009.meaning1: population of the world; community of the world

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana evaṃ pabbajito samāno kāmavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, byāpādavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ, mahā kho pan'āyaṃ lokasannivāso.

56010.meaning1: living in the world; worldly life

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭho samāno na iti paṭisañcikkhati, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ lokasannivāso tathābhūto ayaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho
imā kho citta, lokasamaññā lokaniruttiyo lokavohārā lokapaññattiyo, yāhi tathāgato voharati aparāmasan'ti.

56012.meaning1: source of the world; (comm) truth of arising

examples.text: lokasamudayaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke n'atthitā sā na hoti. lokanirodhaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke atthitā sā na hoti.
api c'āhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.

56013.meaningLit: discourse on the origin of the world

56022.grammar: masc, loc sg of loka, irreg form of lokasmiṃ

examples.text: yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda, dukkham'addakkhi sallato, ubhay'antarena n'āhosi, kena lokasmi kiṃ siyā.
hirīnisedho puriso, koci lokasmi vijjati, yo nindaṃ apabodheti, asso bhadro kasā'm'iva.

56023.meaning1: tumour in the world; cancer in the world; (comm) cause of destruction in the world

examples.text: kiṃsu issariyaṃ loke, kiṃsu bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ. kiṃsu satthamalaṃ loke, kiṃsu lokasmim'abbudaṃ.
vaso issariyaṃ loke, itthī bhaṇḍānam'uttamaṃ, kodho satthamalaṃ loke, corā lokasmim'abbudā.
gamanena na pattabbo, lokass'anto kudācanaṃ, na ca appatvā lok'antaṃ, dukkhā atthi pamocanaṃ.

56026.meaning1: worldly offence; transgression by worldly standards
56026.commentary: (VBt) yasmā anādariyacittatā nāma kevalaṃ akusalam'eva, tañ'ca pakatiyā vajjaṃ, tasmā idaṃ lokavajjaṃ.

examples.text: katamaṃ, mahārāja, lokavajjaṃ? dasa akusalakammapathā, idaṃ vuccati lokavajjaṃ. katamaṃ paṇṇattivajjaṃ?

56027.meaning1: who is attached to the world; who indulges in the world
56027.commentary: (DHPa) lokavaḍḍhano'ti yo hi evaṃ karoti, so lokavaḍḍhano nāma hoti. tasmā evaṃ akaraṇena na siyā lokavaḍḍhano'ti

examples.text: hīnaṃ dhammaṃ na seveyya, pamādena na saṃvase, micchādiṭṭhiṃ na seveyya, na siyā lokavaḍḍhano.

56028.meaning1: related to a theory about the world
56028.commentary: (MNa) lokavādappaṭisaṃyuttā'ti sassato attā ca loko cā'tiādinayappavattena lokavādena paṭisaṃyuttā

examples.text: yā imā, bhante, anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti, attavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā lokavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā, ādim'eva nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno manasikaroto evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hotī'ti?

56029.meaning2: view associated with theories about the world

56030.meaning1: who knows the world; who understands the universe; epithet of the Buddha
56030.commentary: (ANa) lokavidū'ti tayo loke vidite pākaṭe katvā ṭhito. (ITIa) sabbathā viditalokattā lokavidū

examples.text: pasayha māraṃ abhibhuyya antakaṃ, yo ca phusī jātikkhayaṃ padhānavā, so tādiso lokavidū sumedho, sabbesu dhammesu atam'mayo munī'ti.
iti'pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā'ti.

56032.meaning1: worldly name; common expression; worldly designation

examples.text: imā kho citta, lokasamaññā lokaniruttiyo lokavohārā lokapaññattiyo, yāhi tathāgato voharati aparāmasan'ti.

56033.meaning1: taking the world as an authority; dependent on public opinion

examples.text: passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipateyyako ca, lok'ādhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī, dhamm'ādhipo ca anudhammacārī, na hīyati saccaparakkamo muni.

56035.meaning1: fellowship with the ruler of the world; company of god almighty

examples.text: maññām'ahaṃ lok'ādhipatisahabyataṃ, ākaṅkhamāno tidivaṃ anuttaraṃ, kasmā bhavaṃ vijanam'araññam'assito, tapo idha kubbasi brahmapattiyā'ti.

56036.meaning1: fact of taking the world as an authority; dependence on public opinion

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, ādhipateyyāni. katamāni tīṇi? att'ādhipateyyaṃ, lok'ādhipateyyaṃ, dhamm'ādhipateyyaṃ.
so lokaṃ'y'eva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, lok'ādhipateyyaṃ.

56037.meaning1: having compassion for the world; who takes pity on the world

examples.text: tathāgataṃ arahantaṃ, candimā saraṇaṃ gato, rāhu candaṃ pamuñcassu, buddhā lok'ānukampakā'ti.

56038.meaning2: sympathy with the world of men
56038.commentary: (MNa) lok'ānukampāyā'ti lokassa anukamp'atthāya, mettā-karuṇā-sampattiyā mātāpitaro viya lokassa rakkhitā gopayitā'ti.

examples.text: caratha, bhikkhave, cārikaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lok'ānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ, mā ekena dve agamittha

56039.meaning1: worldliness; material pleasure; worldly pleasure; material delight
56039.commentary: (SNa) lok'āmisan'ti dve lok'āmisā pariyāyena ca nippariyāyena ca. pariyāyena tebhūmakavaṭṭaṃ lok'āmisaṃ, nippariyāyena cattāro paccayā. idha pariyāyalok'āmisaṃ adhippetaṃ.

examples.text: upanīyati jīvitam'appam'āyu, jar'ūpanītassa na santi tāṇā, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, lok'āmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho'ti.

56040.meaning1: connected with physical world; related to worldly pursuits
56040.meaningLit: connected with the meat of the world

examples.text: cakkhuviññeyyānaṃ rūpānaṃ iṭṭhānaṃ kantānaṃ manāpānaṃ manoramānaṃ lok'āmisapaṭisaṃyuttānaṃ paṭilābhaṃ vā paṭilābhato samanupassato pubbe vā paṭiladdhapubbaṃ atītaṃ niruddhaṃ vipariṇataṃ samanussarato uppajjati somanassaṃ.

56041.meaning1: bond with material pleasure; connection to worldly pursuits
56041.meaningLit: bond with the meat of the world

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritattāya. evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, āneñj'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye lok'āmisasaṃyojane se pavutte.

56042.meaning1: intent on material pleasure; fixated on worldly gain
56042.commentary: (MNa) lokāmisādhimutto'ti vaṭṭ'āmisa-kām'āmisa-lok'āmisa-bhūtesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu adhimutto tanninno taggaruko tappabbhāro.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco purisapuggalo lok'āmis'ādhimutto assa.

56043.meaning1: attachment to the things of the world; clinging to material pleasures
56043.meaningLit: bringing near the meat of the world

examples.text: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā y'āyaṃ upekkhā nānattā nānattasitā taṃ abhinivajjetvā, y'āyaṃ upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā yattha sabbaso lok'āmis'ūpādānā aparisesā nirujjhanti tam'ev'ūpekkhaṃ bhāveti.

56044.meaning1: natural philosophy; materialistic philosophy; (comm) science of disputation
56044.notes: (MW) materialism, the system of atheistical philosophy (taught by Cārvāka)

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.

56045.meaning1: materialistic philosophy and the auspicious marks of a great man

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.

56046.notes: (MW) materialism, the system of atheistical philosophy (taught by Cārvāka)

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā

56047.meaning2: who holds the view of nature-lore, nihilist

examples.text: atha kho dve lok'āyatikā brāhmaṇā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.

56056.meaning1: mundane and supramundane; worldly and transcendental

examples.text: evam'idaṃ puññaṃ pavaḍḍhatī'ti evaṃ idaṃ lokiyalok'uttaraṃ puññaphalaṃ vaḍḍhati, puññaphalanti ca upar'ūpari puññam'pi puññavipāko'pi veditabbo.

paññānirodhiko'ti anuppannāya lokiyalok'uttarāya paññāya uppajjituṃ na deti, lokiyapaññaṃ pana aṭṭhasamāpatti-pañc'ābhiññā-vasena uppannam'pi samucchinditvā khipatī'ti paññānirodhiko. vighātapakkhiko'ti dukkhakoṭṭhāsiko.

56059.meaning1: mundane right view; worldly correct outlook

56060.meaning1: seeing the basis for worldly right view, etc.

examples.text: sammādiṭṭhiṃ'p'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, dvayaṃ vadāmi. atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi sāsavā puññabhāgiyā upadhivepakkā, atthi, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
ye te sutt'antā tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīr'atthā lok'uttarā suññatappaṭisaṃyuttā, tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti

56070.commentary: (MNa) lokkhasammatā'ti lūkhabhāvasammatā, lūkhabhāvan'ti cokkhabhāvaṃ, visuddhibhāvaṃ detī'ti evaṃ sammatā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. lokyasammatā'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: lokkhasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.

examples.text: lokkhasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.
lokhyasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.

56073.meaning1: considered to give purity; (comm) (or) considered to lead to the highest plane of existence
56073.commentary: (MNa) lokkhasammatā'ti lūkhabhāvasammatā, lūkhabhāvan'ti cokkhabhāvaṃ, visuddhibhāvaṃ detī'ti evaṃ sammatā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. lokyasammatā'ti'pi pāṭho. tass'attho, seṭṭhaṃ lokaṃ gamayatī'ti evaṃ sammatā'ti.

examples.text: lokhyasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, puññasammatā hi, bho gotama, bāhukā nadī bahujanassa, bāhukāya pana nadiyā bahujano pāpakammaṃ kataṃ pavāhetī'ti.

56074.meaning1: who plucks out; who tears out

examples.text: kesamassulocako'pi hoti kesamassulocan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako'pi hoti āsanappaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko'pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto, kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'pi hoti kaṇṭak'āpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

56075.synonym: akkha, akkhi, cakkhu, dassana, nayana, netta

examples.text: ahaṃ tava vas'ānugo siyaṃ, yadi viharemase kānan'antare, na hi m'atthi tayā piyattaro, pāṇo kinnarimandalocane.

kesamassulocako'pi hoti kesamassulocan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako'pi hoti āsanappaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko'pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānam'anuyutto, kaṇṭak'āpassayiko'pi hoti kaṇṭak'āpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyatatiyakam'pi udak'orohan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.

56084.meaning1: salt-maker's boy; (comm) boy from Loṇakāra village

examples.text: evaṃ vutte rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto kupito anattamano upakaṃ maṇḍikāputtaṃ etadavoca, yāva dhaṃsī vat'āyaṃ loṇakāradārako yāva mukharo yāva pagabbo yatra hi nāma taṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ āsādetabbaṃ maññissati, apehi tvaṃ, upaka, vinassa, mā taṃ addasan'ti.

56085.commentary: (SNa) loṇaghaṭāyā'ti cakkavāḷamukhavaṭṭiyā ādhārakaṃ katvā mukhavaṭṭiyā brahmalokaṃ āhacca ṭhitāya loṇacāṭiyā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, mahatiyā loṇaghaṭāya parittā loṇasakkharāya yāva'd'eva upanikkhepanamattāya, evam'eva kho mayaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa yāva'd'eva upanikkhepanamattāya.

56086.meaning2: flavouring with salt and spices; salting and smoking

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso loṇaphalaṃ paritte udakamallake pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu taṃ parittaṃ udakaṃ amunā loṇaphalena loṇaṃ assa apeyyan'ti? evaṃ, bhante.
